channel.title: Synthetic negatives (not real news)
channel.description: Synthetic items written for keysentry tests. None of them describes a breach of a platform's stored credentials, so none may trigger a rotation even when two outlets carry them.

item.title: Railway suffers multi-hour deployment outage after database upgrade
item.description: Deployments on Railway failed for about three hours on Monday after a database upgrade went wrong. The company said no customer data was affected and service is restored.

item.title: Phishing campaign impersonates Railway and Vercel to steal developer logins
item.description: Attackers are sending fake billing emails that imitate Railway and Vercel and lead to look-alike login pages that capture credentials. Neither company's systems were breached.

item.title: Acme Analytics breach exposes customer API keys; company was hosted on Railway
item.description: Acme Analytics said an attacker used a stolen employee laptop to access its admin panel and exposed customer API keys. Acme runs its services on Railway, which was not involved in the incident.
